name: skill-authoring
description: Skill authoring for any repository: design skill changes, write their files, turn their standards into checked rules, review them with independent agents, and audit which skills to create, update, merge, or skip.

interface.shortDescription: Design, write, check, review, and audit skills
interface.longDescription: Use Skill Authoring to carry a skill change from design to release, design one skill change before its files change, write one skill's files from its accepted design or make a mechanical edit, turn its standards into checked rules, review it with independent agents, and audit which skills a repository should create, update, merge, or skip.
defaultPrompt: Use skill-orchestrator to carry this skill change from design to release.
Use skill-design to design one skill change before its files change.
Use skill-creation to write one skill's files from its accepted design.
Use skill-rules to turn this skill's standards into checked rules.
Use skill-review to independently review this skill.
Use skill-audit to audit these skills against session evidence.
